question: How do I complete the achievement '...Anyone can be a gourmet.'?
ground_truth: Fail the cooking mini-game and produce 10 Suspicious-quality dishes to unlock this achievement.

result.output: To complete the achievement "...Anyone can be a gourmet." in Genshin Impact, you need to: fail the cooking mini-game 10 times to produce Suspicious-quality dishes. You can do this by intentionally missing the timing window when cooking any dish. Note: If a character has a talent that gives a chance to produce a special dish on failure (e.g., Hu Tao, Ayato), those special dishes do not count towards this achievement. You must receive the actual "Suspicious" rarity dish. Simply cook repeatedly and fail the timing until you have obtained 10 Suspicious dishes. The achievement will unlock automatically.
result.summary: 用户询问如何完成成就，客服建议故意失败烹饪10次以获得可疑品质菜肴。
